TypeTaxonScript is a framework for managing taxonomic data collaboratively. It allows users to create, edit, and share taxonomic information in a structured format.

[https://doi.org/10.1093/biomethods/bpae017](https://doi.org/10.1093/biomethods/bpae017)

It is better read in PDF format, which can be downloaded from the link below.

[https://academic.oup.com/biomethods/article-pdf/9/1/bpae017/57136701/bpae017.pdf](https://academic.oup.com/biomethods/article-pdf/9/1/bpae017/57136701/bpae017.pdf)
